name: RackPeek
description: A webui and CLI tool to discover, manage, and document your home lab and small-scale IT infrastructure. Track hardware, services, networks, and their relationships using open, non-proprietary YAML.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-rackpeek application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-rackpeek
  # The `big-bear-rackpeek` service definition
  big-bear-rackpeek:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-rackpeek
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: aptacode/rackpeek:v2.1.0@sha256:139f88077fde2bed96acdd650573263a7dcfbf94dabec7bfca17e9b46f0941be
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/app/config
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8095 of the host to port 8080 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
